verdict.rationale: Ashby ships Ashby Assistant, a built-in chat-based agent that takes plain-language requests and acts across the product: analyzing pipelines, updating candidates and drafting emails. It also supports custom agents for repeated workflows, respects existing user permissions, and is reachable from Slack. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's task execution, and in-depth documentation of action scope, limits, or review/confirmation of actions before they run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: A chat-based agent that lets you ask questions in plain language and take action across Ashby from a single interface. Analyze pipelines, update candidates, draft emails, and more, with custom agents for repeated workflows.
Today, we're releasing Ashby Assistant, a chat-based agent that lets you ask questions in plain language
Your existing Ashby permissions apply, so it can only read and act on information you can already access.
Ask questions, submit feedback, call custom agents, and more directly from Slack.
